newsitem.title: USA: Nitinol heart implant to be sold in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Nitinol heart implant to be sold in Europe.

text.p: Nitinol Medical Technologies Inc on Monday said its CardioSEAL Septal Occluder - an implant device designed to close holes in the heart - will be available commercially in Europe next month.
Nitinol said it will begin shipping the product for delivery to new treatment centers in June. Training for pedriatic cardiologists, the target market for the product, will begin at the same time.

The CardioSEAL has been used in five centers in Europe during a clinical trial begun in October 1996. Nitinol said the product was successfully implanted in 23 of 24 pediatric patients at two of the trial centers. Other trial centers are expected to report results shortly, it said.
Nitinol said the CardioSEAL is also being tested at 10 centers in the United States and one in Canada.
The device is used primarily on children with congenital heart defects, but it may also be used in adults, Nitinol president Thomas Tully said.
Nitinol said it will market the product directly to the 300 to 400 pedriatric surgeons comprising its target market.
Trial results were reported last week at the World Congress of Pediatric Cardiology and Cardiac Surgery.
